user.title: Select an Allegro One Box
user.description: Read public PM2.5 and PM10 measurements directly from Allegro. Find a One Box anywhere in Poland.

menu_options.manual: Enter a code, ID, or link

nearby.title: Find One Boxes on the map
nearby.description: Choose any location in Poland. The search uses a square extending the chosen distance north, south, east, and west. Start with 2 km; reduce the area if Allegro groups points into clusters.

select.title: Select a One Box
select.description: Choose a point, ordered by distance from your selected location. Its address will appear in the entry after confirmation. Some points may currently have no air-quality data.

manual.title: Enter a One Box
manual.description: Enter a public One Box code (for example AL012WE1), a numeric pointId, or an Allegro map link containing pointId. The code lookup covers Poland.

data.point_id: One Box code, numeric ID, or Allegro map link

error.invalid_point: Enter a One Box code, numeric pointId, or an HTTPS Allegro map link containing pointId.
error.access_blocked: Allegro refused access or returned a CAPTCHA (HTTP 403/429). Try again later.
error.point_not_found: This ID does not identify an Allegro One Box, or the point is not available.
error.invalid_data: Allegro returned invalid or outdated measurement data. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Allegro. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_location: Choose valid coordinates and a search distance from 0.2 to 20 km.
error.area_too_large: Allegro grouped some points into clusters. Reduce the search distance or use a One Box code to select a specific point.
error.no_points: No One Boxes were returned in this area. Move the map, adjust the distance, or enter a One Box code.

abort.already_configured: This One Box is already configured.
